vehicle.notes: UK RHD. Ford LH/RH = vehicle's own left/right (LH = UK nearside/N/S = passenger side; RH = offside/O/S = driver side). Numbers were read from web-search results (titles and extracts) of the cited pages. Page fetches were blocked (shop.ford.co.uk did not resolve). Ford UK shop numbers are 7-digit finis codes; eBay numbers are engineering numbers. Partial coverage: the shared web-search budget ran out after 32 searches on this vehicle, before wings, liners, mirrors, doors, rear bumper, tail lamps, tailgate, sensors, wheels and cooling parts were searched. Pre-facelift (2017-2021) and facelift (2022-2023) parts differ; check each number against the VIN before use.

parts.description: Front bumper cover, primed, without parking-sensor (PDC) holes, standard (non-ST-Line) style
parts.notes: eBay UK listing for an aftermarket insurance-approved bumper titled 'FORD FIESTA MK8 2017 ON FRONT BUMPER NO PDC PRIMED NEW INSURANCE APPROVED O.E NUMBER =2162026'. The listing says the bumper comes without a tow-eye cover and also gives 2162033 and 2162036, but does not say how they relate. A German-language eBay listing in the same search ('stoßstange vorne für FORD FIESTA (CE1) TREND') also gave 2162026 with engineering number H1BB17757AA, but its URL could not be pinned down from the extract, so this stays single-source. Used genuine Mk8 bumpers on eBay UK carry only the truncated engineering number H1BB-17757-A (e.g. https://www.ebay.co.uk/p/13013850171). Pre-facelift style; the 2022 facelift bumper is different. Not for cars with parking sensors.
Ford UK shop title 'Fiesta Upper Radiator Grille Titanium 2021-2023'. Facelift (2021-2023) Titanium only. Price not seen.

parts.description: Front bumper towing eye cover, primed (standard bumper)
parts.notes: Winparts (UK) lists a Diederichs tow-hook flap for the Fiesta VII (Continental name for Mk8), 2017 on, with OE number 2085065. Also given as the manufacturer part number for a primed black front tow-eye cover for the 2017 Mk8 Fiesta at https://www.ebay.com/itm/306263600538, which also lists H1BB-17A989-A1 as a reference. ST-Line, ST and Active bumpers may use a different cover.

eBay UK title 'Bonnet Hood PH1BB-A16610-AH FORD FIESTA MK8 17-'. Also at https://www.ebay.co.uk/p/16048011833?iid=315719483896 ('Ford Mk8 Fiesta Bonnet Blue Metallic Ph1bb-a16610-ah 17 to 21'). A new genuine bonnet was also listed as H1BB-A16610-AH (without the service P prefix), but its URL was not captured. One UK breaker lists a Mk8 bonnet as H1BB-A16854-AE (https://ace.eladeneparts.com/donor-parts?id=1819); that number was not cross-checked. Finis code not seen. Seen on 2017-2021 cars; facelift fitment not checked.

eBay UK title 'Genuine Ford Fiesta Mk8 O/s Bonnet Hinge 2017- 2087959'. The search extracts give engineering number H1BB-A16800-AA alongside it. Another eBay listing ('Ford Fiesta 2017-2021 MK8 Front Right Driver OS Bonnet Hood Hinge 2087959 Genuine') was seen, but its URL was not captured, so this stays single-source. LH hinge not confirmed.
Ford UK shop title 'FIESTA MK8 BONNET STAY ROD 2017-'. The Mk8 holds the bonnet up with a stay rod, not gas struts. The stay-rod retaining clip is a separate part (2110512 on the Ford UK shop).
